title: SortItOut Donation Guide: Initial Content Seed
purpose: Prototype seed taxonomy and tips; NOT a verified acceptance database

evidence_key.specific_item_donate_rule: An item-level Donate rule exists in item_disposal_rules.csv; it is conditional, not a verified site match
evidence_key.editorial_example_from_broad_category: Human-readable search example proposed under a broad donation category; not an item-level acceptance claim

eligibility_keys.conditional: Potentially suitable for donation if working/usable and approved by a receiving organization
eligibility_keys.category_example: Candidate item; category match only. Confirm with recipient
eligibility_keys.special_review: Specialist acceptance or safety checks required
eligibility_keys.special_program: Only through relevant verified specialized program
eligibility_keys.not_standard: Do not recommend ordinary thrift-store donation

data_warnings: All 1391 donation directory location records are research_only and unverified
All 1787 donation acceptance records are review_required
Donation acceptance records have no item_id or category_id; original_accepted_material is a comma-separated category string, sometimes truncated
facility_acceptance_rules.csv references facility_service_id; these uploads lack a table mapping it to facility_id
Do not claim that a named facility accepts a specific item without a verified bridge and operator confirmation
A directory listing might be a seller or redistribution entity rather than a residential donation drop-off

site_categories.name: Clothing & Accessories
site_categories.general_tip: Wash and dry fabric items; remove personal belongings; check for stains, odors, and damage before offering them for reuse.
site_categories.caution: Textile recycling accepts some worn textiles that a thrift store may not resell; site eligibility differs.

site_categories.name: Furniture & Home Goods
site_categories.general_tip: Clean items, check structural safety, remove loose contents, and measure large pieces. Ask the recipient about pickup and drop-off before transporting furniture.
site_categories.caution: Many recipients exclude mattresses and damaged upholstered furniture; do not assume every listed center can accept bulky items.

site_categories.name: Books, Media & School Supplies
site_categories.general_tip: Keep books dry and free of mold; bundle media by type and confirm format or age restrictions. Donate usable stationery in organized sets.
site_categories.caution: Organizations often accept only selected book types or clean, usable materials.
site_categories.alternative: Resell / Swap or Share / Paper Recycling

site_categories.name: Electronics & Appliances
site_categories.general_tip: Test the device, remove accounts and personal data, factory-reset when possible, and include compatible power supplies. Confirm recipient acceptance.
site_categories.caution: NYC prohibits certain covered e-waste from regular trash or curbside recycling. Small appliances have different rules.

site_categories.name: Toys & Baby Items
site_categories.general_tip: Clean items, ensure all pieces are present, check recalls, and confirm age and safety requirements with the recipient.
site_categories.caution: Car seats require a safety-history and recall check and explicit recipient approval; do not treat baby equipment as automatically suitable.

site_categories.name: Sports, Music & Hobbies
site_categories.general_tip: Check that items work, are complete and safe to use; clean them and disclose wear or needed repairs.
site_categories.caution: Specialist organizations may be better suited than general thrift stores.

site_categories.name: Tools & Building Materials
site_categories.general_tip: Clean and organize reusable components; list exact quantities, dimensions and condition. Ask reuse centers about material and size restrictions.
site_categories.caution: Paint and hazardous products are not ordinary donations; use an appropriate verified reuse or take-back program.

site_categories.name: Food & Daily Essentials
site_categories.general_tip: Check packaging, expiry or best-by dates, recipient eligibility, and safe storage; keep unopened goods sealed and properly labeled.
site_categories.caution: Food donation should go to eligible food programs; not every directory entry accepts food from individual households.

site_categories.name: Specialized Donations
site_categories.general_tip: Contact specialist organizations; confirm their exact eligibility, safety and documentation requirements.
site_categories.caution: Prescription medications are not suitable general donations; use approved medication take-back routes.
